connections.label: The customer's CDN sends its access logs to Brand Visibility, which reads them for AI-agent and referral traffic
connections.how: Brand Visibility generates the storage credentials and path; the customer's CDN team creates the log job in its CDN console. Adobe has guides for Akamai, Cloudflare, Amazon CloudFront, Fastly and Imperva, and any other CDN or log store can upload files in Adobe's format. Without it, the Agentic Traffic dashboard can't display metrics.

source.title: Experience League: Brand Visibility, CDN log forwarding

gain.title: AI-agent traffic

flows.what: Access logs on the CDN's schedule, processed once a day

source.title: Experience League: Brand Visibility, CDN log forwarding

prereqs: The customer's CDN team creates the log job in its CDN console
A Brand Visibility user who can manage the CDN configuration
For any other CDN or a log store, an export in Adobe's file format with the exact field names

connections.label: Warehouse tables come into Experience Platform datasets that a CJA connection reads
connections.availability: Needs CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate (Data Mirror), or separately licensed warehouse connectors
connections.how: With Data Mirror, a Snowflake, Google BigQuery or Azure Databricks source keeps inserts, updates and deletes in sync in relational datasets, which the CJA connection joins on a person or account ID.

source.title: Experience League: CJA and Data Mirror
